body.statement:
Assume \(p_0\in\operatorname{relint}(\mathcal P_{\mathrm{ASC}})\), \(\operatorname{im}(B)\subseteq\operatorname{lin}(\mathcal P_{\mathrm{ASC}}-p_0)\), and \(p_n(u)-p_0\in\operatorname{lin}(\mathcal P_{\mathrm{ASC}}-p_0)\).  Also assume multinomial interiority, \(p_n(0)\to p_0\), the compact-uniform centered local expansion, effective moving-offset encoding, and \(c_n\to0\).  Then every fixed compact is contained in \(\mathcal U_n\) eventually, and
\[
 \max_j\sup_{u\in C}|e_{n,j}(u)|\to0,
 \qquad
 [B'\operatorname{diag}\{p_n(0)\}^{-1}B]^{-1}\to\Sigma_0.
\]
Conditional on effective compatibility density, every finite atomic Gaussian dual certificate has a lawful compact multinomial realization whose value differs by the explicit positive-cell comparison remainder, and therefore
\[
 \liminf_{n\to\infty}M_n\ge M_{\mathfrak G_0,\eta_0}(r_0).
\]
The reverse inequality requires the construction, rather than the assumption, of one sequence \(K_n\in\mathcal C_{n,\eta_0}\) that is globally honest on all unbounded regions \(D_{n,v}\) and satisfies
\[
 \limsup_{n\to\infty}\sup_{u\in H_{n,r_0}}
 E_{p_n(u)}[\ell_0\{K_n(N_n)\}]
 \le M_{\mathfrak G_0,\eta_0}(r_0).
\]
Once that construction is proved,
\[
 \lim_{n\to\infty}M_n=M_{\mathfrak G_0,\eta_0}(r_0).
\]
body.justification: The corrected theorem preserves both minimax inequalities and makes zero-offset centering, lawful compact domains, remainder and covariance convergence, and the single global primal construction explicit.
body.gap: Finite dual supports can be localized, but escaping separated means prevent the currently available compact arguments from proving the reverse inequality.
body.consumer: Only a completed two-sided result can justify interpreting the Gaussian certificate as the local multinomial minimax value.

obligation.what_is_open: Prove the finite-certificate lower transfer using a quantitative comparison kernel and construct one sequence of rules that is globally honest on every unbounded finite-sample label region while controlling risk uniformly on the entire finite-sample separated domain.
obligation.obstruction: Every fixed compact is eventually lawful, but compact comparison gives no control over means escaping all compacts. Full-set reporting outside an expanding core preserves honesty but can have diameter loss one, so it does not prove the required minimax upper bound.
obligation.attempted: Relative-interior lifting, zero-offset centering, compact domain inclusion, remainder and covariance convergence, localized finite dual supports, diagonal compact exhaustion, and exact full-set repair were combined. None controls the unbounded separated-risk supremum.
obligation.partial_result: The relative-interior lift and affine-hull condition prove eventual lawfulness of every fixed compact.  Zero-offset centering, compact moving-remainder convergence, and covariance convergence identify \(\mathfrak G_0\) there.  Consequently every finite Gaussian dual support can be localized once a quantitative comparison kernel is available.  No proved construction controls one primal rule uniformly over separated means in \(H_{n,r_0}\) that escape every compact; reporting the full label set outside a core can raise maximal diameter loss to one.
